summary: Today, in the Consumer Financial Protection Bureau’s (CFPB) November 12, 2021 lawsuit against FirstCash, Inc., and nineteen subsidiaries alleging violations of the Military Lending Act (MLA), the parties reached a settlement and jointly filed a stipulated final judgment and proposed order, which if entered by the court, would resolve the lawsuit.

title: CFPB Amends Wise Order for Remittance Practices
summary: The CFPB amended its January 30, 2025 consent order with the international remittance company Wise resolving claims including advertising inaccurate fees and failing to properly disclose exchange rates and other costs.

title: CFPB Announcement Regarding Enforcement Actions Related to Buy Now, Pay Later Loans
summary: The CFPB is announcing that it will not prioritize enforcement actions taken on the basis of the Truth in Lending (Regulation Z); Use of Digital User Accounts to Access Buy Now, Pay Later Loans, 89 Fed. Reg. 47,068 (May 31, 2024) (“Buy Now, Pay Later”).

title: CFPB Keeps Its Enforcement and Supervision Resources Focused on Pressing Threats to Consumers
summary: The CFPB is announcing that it will not prioritize enforcement or supervision actions with regard to entities that are currently outside the stay imposed under Texas Bankers Association v. CFPB, No. 24-40705 (CA5).

title: CFPB Offers Regulatory Relief From Registration Requirements for Small Loan Providers
summary: The Consumer Financial Protection Bureau will not prioritize enforcement or supervision actions for entities that do not satisfy future deadlines to submit registration information under the regulation titled "Registry of Nonbank Covered Persons Subject to Certain Agency and Court Orders".

title: 2024 HMDA Data on Mortgage Lending Now Available
summary: The published data contain loan-level information filed by financial institutions and modified to protect consumer privacy.

title: CFPB Offers Regulatory Relief for Small Loan Providers
summary: The Bureau will keep its enforcement and supervision resources focused on pressing threats to consumers, particularly servicemen and veterans.

title: CFPB Seeks to Vacate Abusive, Unjust Case Against Townstone
Statement on Designation of Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent as Acting Director of the Consumer Financial Protection Bureau
summary: On January 31, 2025, President Trump designated Secretary of the Treasury Scott Bessent as Acting Director of the Consumer Financial Protection Bureau (CFPB).

title: OCC Imposes $750 Million Assessment Against Bank of America for Deficient BSA/AML Compliance
summary: The Office of the Comptroller of the Currency (OCC) today announced a $750 million civil money penalty against Bank of America, N.A. (bank), for violations of the Bank Secrecy Act and its implementing regulations, including 12 CFR 21.21 and 12 CFR 21.11. This amount is the largest in OCC history.

title: OCC Allows National Banks and Federal Savings Associations in Alabama, Florida, and Mississippi Affected by Hurricane Isaias to Close
summary: The Office of the Comptroller of the Currency (OCC) today issued a proclamation allowing national banks, federal savings associations, and federal branches and agencies of foreign banks to close offices in areas of Alabama and Mississippi affected by Hurricane Isaias.

title: OCC Assesses $350 Million Civil Money Penalty Against American Express
summary: The Office of the Comptroller of the Currency (OCC) today announced a cease-and-desist order and a $350 million civil money penalty against American Express National Bank, Sandy, Utah (bank), for deficiencies in the bank's Bank Secrecy Act (BSA) and anti-money laundering (AML) compliance program.

title: Comptroller Gould Announces New Efforts to Combat Financial Fraud in Minnesota
summary: Comptroller of the Currency Jonathan V. Gould today convened a panel of community bankers in Minneapolis, Minnesota, to discuss ongoing efforts to combat financial fraud.

title: OCC Hails 2026 Update to U.S. National Strategy for Financial Literacy
summary: The Office of the Comptroller of the Currency (OCC) today hailed the 2026 update to the U.S. National Strategy for Financial Literacy, underscoring the agency's commitment to helping Americans develop practical skills to make sound financial decisions, build greater financial security, and pursue economic opportunity.

title: OCC Releases CRA Performance Evaluations for 13 National Banks and Federal Savings Associations
summary: The Office of the Comptroller of the Currency (OCC) today released a list of Community Reinvestment Act (CRA) performance evaluations that became public during the period of September 1, 2026, through September 30, 2026.

title: OCC Reports Second Quarter 2026 Bank Trading Revenue
summary: The Office of the Comptroller of the Currency (OCC) reported cumulative trading revenue of U.S. commercial banks and savings associations of $21.6 billion in the second quarter of 2026. The second quarter trading revenue was $5.3 billion, or 32.5 percent, more than in the previous quarter and $5.1 billion, or 30.6 percent, more than a year earlier.

title: Comptroller Issues Statement Explaining Vote Against Resolution Plan Feedback for American Express, Reasserts Need for Reforms to Resolution Planning
summary: Comptroller of the Currency Jonathan V. Gould today issued a statement on his vote against a joint resolution plan letter from the Federal Deposit Insurance Corporation and the Federal Reserve Board to American Express and reaffirmed the need for reforms to Dodd-Frank Act Section 165(d) resolution plans.

title: Remarks by Comptroller Gould before the Military Banking Summit 2026
summary: Comptroller of the Currency Jonathan V. Gould today discussed the importance of a regulatory and supervisory framework that supports the military community in remarks at the Military Banking Summit.

title: OCC Reports Mortgage Performance for Second Quarter of 2026
summary: The Office of the Comptroller of the Currency (OCC) reported on the performance of first-lien mortgages in the federal banking system during the second quarter of 2026.

title: Pluto Security Secures $42 Million to Protect Corporate AI Without Blocking Innovation
summary: Pluto Security emerged from stealth Tuesday (Oct. 13), saying in a blog post that the company has secured $42 million in funding for its security solution for artificial intelligence tools. Pluto Security’s product is designed to provide the complete enterprise security needed by companies whose employees are integrating AI agents, coding tools, browser extensions and other AI tools …

title: Sponsor's message: [On-Demand Webinar] AI Without The Hype: What AML Transformation Means
summary: [On-Demand Webinar] AI Without The Hype: What AML Transformation Means

title: Launch of the Women Entrepreneurs (WE) Finance Code in Albania
summary: Address by Mr Gent Sejko, Governor of the Bank of Albania, at the launch of the Women Entrepreneurs (WE) Finance Code in Albania, Tirana, 8 September 2026.

title: Changing without losing sight of the goal
summary: Welcome address (virtually) by Andriy Pyshnyy, Governor of the National Bank of Ukraine, at the 10th National Bank of Ukraine and Narodowy Bank Polski (NBU-NBP) Annual Research Conference "Central banks’ response to future challenges: resilience, credibility, and innovation", Kyiv, 21 September 2026.
